summary: Frontend smoke test at 390x844: login/dashboard, metrics, navigation, overflow, and initial UI rendering passed. PO modal save becomes outside viewport after form input, blocking completion; subsequent flows were not claimed.

ui_bugs.issue: After filling modal fields on a 390x844 viewport, Save PO is rendered outside the viewport and Playwright cannot tap it, even with force=True. Modal appears to close/shift while keyboard/focus is active. Reproduced twice.

integration_issues.issue: Save action could not be completed from the mobile web flow because the save control was outside the viewport after input.

issues: Keyboard/input focus causes the bottom-sheet action to be inaccessible at 390x844; ensure modal content/action scrolls into view and keyboard dismissal is handled.

action_items: Fix Add PO modal keyboard/viewport handling so Save PO remains reachable after filling fields on 390x844; retest PO creation and then remaining Operational, Salary, and Profile flows.
Consider controlled state and validation for Add PO fields; current save is a local alert-only action.
critical_code_review_comments: The requested prototype flows are implemented locally in index.tsx, but PO save, operational submit, password save, notifications, and sign-out are alert/local state actions rather than persisted integrations.
The Field helper assigns testIDs from labels, but repeated labels such as Project produce duplicate testIDs across screens; scope selectors by screen/modal for robust automation.
Login accepts any non-empty credentials and maps all non-owner users to Budi; demo credentials are quick-fill only and are not validated.

success_rate.frontend: approximately 60% of executed checks passed; PO flow blocked and remaining dependent checks not claimed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Owner credentials read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Login, dashboard metrics, horizontal overflow, and navigation to PO were verified. PO modal save failed twice after input at 390x844 due to outside-viewport interaction. Do not claim unexecuted remaining flows.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: login with demo-Owner, open PO Project, Add PO, fill PO Number/Project/PO Amount, tap Save PO. At 390x844 the modal action is below the visible/scrollable area after input focus; Playwright reports Element is outside of the viewport, including force=True. Likely missing keyboard avoidance or modal ScrollView/action positioning in the bottom sheet.
